title: Pupils hit by floods get aid in time for new term | The Star
text:
Pupils hit by floods get aid in time for new term | The Star
Compiled by FAZLEENA AZIZ, C. ARUNO and R. ARAVINTHAN A TOTAL of 173 pupils from seven Tamil schools who were affected by the recent floods in Selangor received school bags and other necessities from Gabungan Persatuan Masyarakat India Malaysia (Gamia), Malaysia Nanban reported.
Its president Mohan Maduraiveeran said the families were still struggling after the disaster in December.
